summary: The implementation successfully addresses all four requirements (REQ-17 through REQ-20). The frontend task addition functionality has been fixed with proper async/await error handling in TodoInput.tsx. Backend persistence is implemented using List-based stable storage in main.mo with a migration.mo file for safe upgrades. The frontend correctly loads persisted tasks via useGetAllTasks with proper query configuration (staleTime: 0, refetchOnMount: true). All acceptance criteria appear to be met based on the code changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Enhanced console logging for debugging across multiple query hooks
hallucinated_features.reason: The diff shows extensive console.error statements added throughout useQueries.ts (e.g., 'Error fetching tasks:', 'Error adding task:', 'Error toggling task:', etc.). While helpful for debugging, this level of logging was not requested in the BuildRequest.
TodoInput.tsx includes a spinning emoji animation when addTask.isPending is true. The BuildRequest only asked to fix task addition functionality, not to add loading UI indicators.

hallucinated_features.description: Input field remains populated on error
hallucinated_features.reason: The error handling in TodoInput.tsx includes a comment 'Keep the text in the input so user can try again', implementing retry UX that was not specified in requirements.
